position.heading: A new platform for South Asian design in the Gulf
position.lede: Purna is a contemporary South Asian design house based in Dubai. It brings together collectible objects, art, ceramics, vintage pieces, architectural hardware and a tightly edited selection of original furniture.
paragraphs: The house presents work from across South Asia through commissions, collaborations and considered sourcing. Some pieces are developed and produced by Purna; others are selected from independent artists, ceramicists, designers and specialist workshops.
Purna is neither a conventional furniture showroom nor a white-cube gallery. It is a commercially active platform where South Asian design can be discovered, collected, commissioned and specified.

programme.heading: An intentionally layered collection

pillars.name: Architectural hardware

programme.closing: Purna is not conceived as a conventional furniture showroom, but as a changing South Asian design gallery, bringing furniture, art, objects, vintage and hardware together within one evolving programme.

location.heading: A home in Alserkal Avenue
paragraphs: Purna is opening in Alserkal Avenue, Dubai's arts district, among galleries including The Third Line, Lawrie Shabibi, Green Art Gallery and Leila Heller Gallery, and cultural spaces such as Concrete and Cinema Akil.
It will be a permanent setting where work can be experienced in person, through a changing gallery, exhibitions, launches, designer talks and private appointments.

image.alt: The Purna Gallery storefront, its name in bronze letters above a glass front

designers.heading: For designers and studios
intro: Purna is building its inaugural programme and beginning conversations with a small group of designers and studios whose work can help shape a new platform for South Asian design in the Gulf.
We are interested in relationships that evolve over time, from presenting existing work in Dubai to developing exclusive pieces, commissions and new collections together.

ways.title: Representation
ways.text: A physical presence in Dubai for selected existing work, with regional sales, collector relationships and project specification.

ways.title: Commissions & exclusives
ways.text: Exclusive pieces, regional editions and new commissions developed for the gallery or its clients.

ways.title: Long-term collaboration
ways.text: New work, exhibitions and installations over time, with direct access to collectors, architects and the design community.
